key.name: position
key.description: Where in the top bar Super Voice is. Around the clock, it draws two halves, one each side of the clock, that read as one picture. In the status area, it draws the whole picture beside the system icons.

key.name: visualization-style
key.description: How live audio is drawn: one pulse, an equalizer, centered bars, or a waveform.

key.name: working-animation
key.description: What is drawn while Super Voice transcribes, or prepares the first audio of speech.

key.name: palette
key.description: The pair of gradients speech to text and text to speech are drawn in. Accent builds the pair from the system accent color.

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Show the Super Voice icon while nothing is happening. Off leaves the space empty, though it still opens the menu.

key.name: icon-alignment
key.description: Where the icon sits in the space the visualization takes.

key.name: show-visualization
key.description: Draw live audio and the loading animation. Off keeps the indicator to the icon.

key.name: applet-width
key.description: How wide the visualization is, in pixels.
